artworks.title: Ceux de la priemiere heure. "Sire! ou en somme-nous de la guerre fraiche et joyeuse!"
artworks.medium: black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person in full-body profile leaning forward in motion. The person wears a pointed hat or helmet and a cape flowing behind them. The sketch lacks detailed facial features. The person's clothing is form-fitting with no visible objects. The background is minimally detailed with textured lines suggesting motion or speed.

artworks.title: Les notables
artworks.medium: black crayon corrected and white gouache on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures gathered around an individual playing a piano. The sketch is primarily in black and white with a few colored details, such as the face of one figure. The gathering shows figures in long garments, and the piano player is in mid-motion. The background has a loose, sketchy quality with architectural forms in the distance. The texture and shading give a sense of dynamism and movement, suggesting lively interactions.

artworks.title: Sur le Front.  -C'est sa theorie?  -Non, c'est son breviaire.
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink, with corrections by the artist in white opaque watercolor, on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting two figures in a landscape setting. One figure in the foreground is walking while reading a book, wearing a coat and hat. Another pair of figures can be seen in the bottom-left corner. The background features a simple horizon line and emptiness. The drawing shows delicate line work, detailed textures in the clothing, and subtle shading. Handwriting is included in the lower-right corner.

artworks.title: Au Pireê.  -Le depart des boches.
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink, with corrections by the artist in white opaque watercolor, on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a soldier expelling two men from a boat. The image features black and white shading and depicts a scene where a soldier is pushing away two distressed figures. The soldier is wearing a uniform with a cap and has a rifle slung over his shoulder. The drawing uses bold, expressive lines to convey movement and tension. The background shows water with wave outlines, suggesting the setting is on a boat. The drawing captures a moment of power and conflict.

artworks.title: Quand le boche se retire...
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene illustrating movement or action. The image portrays a dynamic scene with figures interacting in a struggle or dance. The forms show a sense of motion through flowing lines and twisting postures. The central focus is on two shapes entangled with each other, suggesting tension or conflict. Each figure has distinct characteristics, with one leaning back while holding onto the central form. The composition features intricate crosshatching and expressive line work, suggesting depth and emotion. The line work captures the essence of the moment.

artworks.title: En 1871
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two half-body figures. One figure, on the left, is standing upright wearing a long-sleeved garment with an emblem over the chest. He has a mustache, short hair, and a stern expression, with one hand on his hip. The second figure, on the right, is less detailed, leaning forward with an obscured face and short hair. The sketch is set on a plain, light-colored background with scribbles and the phrase "En 1871" and a signature in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Au fil de la marne
artworks.medium: red chalk, black crayon, and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a drawing showing small stones or rocks scattered in a flowing body of water. The perspective is slightly elevated, with no distinct horizon line visible. The rocks are partially submerged and depicted with flowing lines. The drawing uses quick, loose strokes in reddish-brown and dark gray tones, giving an impressionistic feel. The color palette is soft and minimal, with pale beige paper and contrast from reddish-brown tones. In the distance, the marks become lighter, creating depth. The artist has signed the piece at the bottom, along with a small handwritten note.

artworks.title: Au Front de Vincennes, Bolo pacha
artworks.medium: crayon in black and blue and brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing two figures in the foreground and several figures in the background. The larger part of the body is shown of both foreground figures, who appear to be in a standing and interacting position. The person on the left in the foreground displays a facial expression with a mustache and short hair that is slightly unkempt. He appears to be wrapped in a draped garment or coat. The person behind him appears to be holding him, and is wearing a cap and uniform with a visible belt. In the background, there is a faintly sketched group of people facing the same direction, potentially a firing squad, with long rifles. The background is indistinct but suggests an outdoor setting with sparse details.

artworks.title: Two Soldiers
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing two figures from the waist up. The person on the left is leaning forward slightly, while the person on the right is kneeling. The person on the left is depicted with a more defined sketch, with distinct facial features drawn in profile, round glasses, a cap, and a long coat with a visible collar. The person on the right has a rough, less defined outline, appears to be smiling, and is wearing a hat with a wide brim and a coat. There are no obvious signs of jewelry or objects being held by either person. The background is plain and uncluttered, with a light beige color, typical of sketch paper.

artworks.title: The Hat of Marshall Foch
artworks.medium: brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This black-and-white illustration features a partial body depiction of a person, focusing on the upper half. The figure is standing, angled slightly to the left, with their hands engaged in an action. They have distinct facial features and are bald with dark sideburns. The individual is dressed in a dark coat, and they appear to be holding a rectangular object. A top hat is placed beside them. The background is plain, emphasizing the person and their surroundings within the illustration.

artworks.title: a) Two French Soldiers near a Notice Board (recto); b) Nursemaid and Children with Horse or Donkey (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) brush and black ink with brown wash on wove paper
b) black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a sketch showing two individuals standing closely together. One figure leans forward with a bent posture, while the other stands upright. The figures have minimal facial features and wear head coverings and loose clothing. One person carries a bag over their shoulder. In the background, there are piles of luggage or sacks, a tall rectangular signpost, and a basic open setting with horizontal lines and an indistinct shape resembling a building.

artworks.title: Nach Paris.  -moi aussi, chai des enfants
artworks.medium: brush and black ink over black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure holding a doll while another figure stands beside, observing. The figure holding the doll is dressed in a long coat and headwear. A small box and other objects are on the ground around them. The drawing uses loose, fluid lines and minimal detail.

artworks.title: En somme ca n'est que du "materiel humain."
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures standing in a field of crosses. One figure appears to be supporting or restraining the other. The scene depicts a moment against a backdrop of crosses, suggesting a cemetery or battlefield. The lines are drawn with shading and texture to give depth to the figures and background, contributing to a somber atmosphere.

artworks.title: Noyon
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows several people manipulating a signpost while another person skis past. One person holds a signpost labeled "NOYON 12 Km", while another person seems to be adjusting its position. In the background, a skier is seen on a sloped terrain. The drawing is done with heavy lines and minimal shading, highlighting the characters' movements and postures in a simple and expressive way.

artworks.title: Bredouilles,  l'Equipage d'un Zeppelin
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a black and white sketch depicting a group of six full-body figures. The central figure stands on the left side with hands clasped behind their back, wearing a heavy coat and a cap or hat. The other figures are positioned to the right, facing this central figure. Two of these figures are interacting closely with the central figure. They all are in long coats and hats, and one of them has bushy facial hair. The background is mostly blank, with faint outlines suggesting other people or structures in the distance. There is text at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Ceux de la priemiere heure.  "Sire! ou en somme-nous de "la guerre fraiche et joyeuse"?..."
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in an interaction. The drawing is in black charcoal or pencil, with sketch-like, energetic quality. On the left, there is a figure wearing a helmet and draped in a cloak, leaning forward. On the right, a second figure appears reclining or fallen, partially obscured by the cape, with visible facial features. The lines are dynamic, capturing movement. The use of lines and shading creates tension and drama. The drawing focuses on the emotional interaction between the two figures.

b) black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures interacting in a room. The figures are shown in a simple, sketch-like style with minimalistic lines and shading. One figure stands closer to the viewer with a slightly hunched posture, while the other figure is positioned further back. They are engaged in an activity that suggests examination or discussion, as one reaches towards or points at a surface or document. The background includes light lines indicating furniture or architectural elements, enhancing the indoor setting. The sketch captures a moment of interaction, focusing on gesture and posture.

artworks.title: Le démobilisé
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two individuals in an interior setting. One person on the left is seen from the waist up, holding pieces of fabric. They appear to have short, dark hair and angular facial features. The person on the right, slightly in profile, is holding a rectangular tray or board. They have a neat appearance with their hair tied back, possibly covered. Both wear simple clothing. The background includes furniture, textiles, and a chair.

artworks.medium:

b) black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows three sketch figures. The first figure on the left is partially sketched, with a vague outline of the body and no distinct facial features. The other two figures, a man and a woman, are depicted standing next to each other. The man is upright with his hands in his coat pockets, wearing a long coat and a cap-like item with unclear facial details. The woman, standing next to him, is slightly bent at the waist, wearing a long flowy garment with indistinct facial features and long black hair framing her face. The background is abstract, with faint graphite outlines resembling buildings or structures against a plain beige surface.

artworks.title: Woman and Two Children with German Soldiers
artworks.medium: brush and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: There is an image of four people depicted in an abstract, sketch-like style. The person on the far left is partially visible, only showing from the knees up, with a hat and coat. The person in the center is shown from head to feet, standing straight and wearing a long garment. This individual's facial features are minimally detailed with slanted eyes and short dark hair. To the right, another adult figure is partially visible from the head down to the thigh area, donning a hat and uniform. The face is sketched with rectangular shapes. The person on the far right is only partially implied with a few lines suggesting a hat and upright posture, with no facial or body details drawn. The background is a plain, light-colored expanse with no additional elements.

artworks.title: -Am Rhien?  -Ya.

artworks.description: The image shows two sketched individuals conversing. One person is standing in profile wearing a coat, helmet, and holding a rifle. The other person is facing them with hands in pockets, wearing a uniform and cap. Boxes are scattered nearby. Background features faint drawings of buildings or structures in the distance.

artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a standing figure holding chains and a seated figure on a bench. The drawing is done in black and white, capturing a moment of interaction. The standing figure holds a set of chains, while the seated figure appears to be slumped or resting, with their head turned slightly away. The scene is rendered with delicate line work and shading, giving depth to the composition. The style of the drawing emphasizes gesture and posture.
